educational_overlay.purpose: Classifies enterprise AI deployments into risk tiers (Prohibited, High Risk, Transparency, Minimal) and maps legal guardrails.
educational_overlay.when_to_use: Before procuring or deploying generative AI models, biometric scanners, or automated decision algorithms.
educational_overlay.when_not_to_use: For traditional rule-based software systems that contain no machine learning models.

variables.label: System Purpose
variables.default: Automated resume filtering for job applicants

educational_overlay.prompt_template:
Classify AI use case: '{{AI_SYSTEM_PURPOSE}}' with oversight model '{{HUMAN_OVERSIGHT}}'.
Map against global AI governance frameworks (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, NITI Aayog Responsible AI).
Identify bias risks, explainability requirements, and audit trail needs.
Mark unverified factors with [VERIFY].
educational_overlay.fictional_scenario: A logistics corporation wants to use an AI computer vision camera to monitor warehouse worker attentiveness and automatically deduct performance bonuses.
educational_overlay.sample_output:
### AI Governance Classification: HIGH RISK
- **Risk Driver**: Workplace surveillance impacting employee compensation without meaningful contestability.
- **Recommendation**: Discontinue automated penalty deductions. Require human supervisor evaluation.
guardrails: Do not deploy fully autonomous biometric categorization in employment contexts.
verification_checklist: Verify training data diversity and bias testing records.
educational_overlay.ai_risk_warning: Models can exhibit algorithmic bias not apparent from documentation alone.
